# secureaccess_service_object (Data Source)

This data source reads the Service Object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_service_object" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the Service Object.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the Service Object.
- `ports` (List of String) List of ports or port ranges of the Service Object.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the Service Object.
